observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a bare Toyota-style inline-4 engine with accessory pulleys, alternator, and wiring harness still attached, sitting in a yard among other stacked engines.
A white barcode/inventory sticker is visible on the block in photos 0 and 1, but no engine code or VIN plate is legible.
Rust/corrosion is visible on a mounting bracket area near the timing cover in photos 0 and 1.
Photo 2 shows the cylinder head with the cam/valve cover removed or open, exposing four cylinder bores and valve area, with hoses and sensors still connected.
No video, sound, or compression-test evidence of the engine running; no oil/coolant condition shown; no transmission attached in any photo.
'POSTED ON JIJI UCHENNA' watermark present, consistent with a listing photo, not proof of content.
